criterionAnalysis: 4.1.3 covers messages that report success, results, progress or errors without taking focus. A control's own label flipping from Show details to Hide details after the user activates it is not such a message, and the state change reaches assistive technology through aria-expanded on the focused button (probe-97760f8ad5f7 reads button [expanded=true]), which is what 4.1.2 asks for. No A or AA criterion fails on this label.
reason: Hide details is the visible label of the Show details disclosure button, which the recipe just activated. The button keeps focus and exposes expanded=true with aria-controls, so the change of state is announced by the control itself.

After Save Limit the modal closes and focus returns to More, and the only trace of the new temporary limit is the Weekly spend limit value changing to $2,500.00 in a plain paragraph. Polling the session every quarter second through the replay found no text in any live region, status or alert at any moment, so screen-reader users get no confirmation that the limit saved. A limit is not a money movement, so it stays medium.
